titulo.estudio: けいご の きほん

intro: Look at the pattern in short examples and check what information it gives in context.

palabras.significado: to be called; to say (humble form)

piezas.titulo: The honorific raises the listener or the person who performs the action; the humble form lowers one's own action in front of that person.
texto: Common forms: いらっしゃる, おっしゃる, なさる and まいる, 申す, いたす, 伺う. The choice depends on who acts and who is spoken to; keigo isn't added to any verb without attention to the context.
しゃちょう は、 らいしゅう しゅっちょう すると おっしゃいました。 (The president said he will travel on business next week.)
わたし は たなか と もうします。 ごご、 せんせい の ところ へ うかがいます。 (My name is Tanaka. This afternoon I will visit the teacher.)
